title: Loveshhuda
desc: Gaurav ends up sleeping with Pooja at his own bachelor party. Even though the matter is soon forgotten and the two go on with their lives, they meet again years later for Pooja's bachelorette party.

title: Tommy - The Lovely Dog
desc: An academic welcomes a canine companion into his household. Meanwhile, the loyal animal provides critical support to the kin during a major life transition.

title: Loveyatri
desc: Sushrut who runs a Garba academy falls in love with a beautiful NRI, Michelle, but her father creates a rift between the two. However, Sushrut is determined to win her back.

title: Raja Saheb Ka Kamra
desc: A television channel decides to host a reality show in a haunted house with seven contestants. The ghosts, however, have their own motives and obstruct the organisers' plans.

title: IIT Krishnamurthy
desc: After returning to Hyderabad, Krishnamurthy, an IIT student from Mumbai, learns about his family. However, when he gets to know about his missing uncle, he sets off to find him.
